Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 7  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded in Step 7 that the death place of Karl Friedrich Otto Westphal was "Berlin-Kreuzberg, Berlin, Germany," despite the Deutsche Biographie explicitly stating "† 27.1.1890 Kreuzlingen (Kanton Thurgau)." This misunderstanding propagated an incorrect expectation for subsequent tasks and created confusion, leading to redundant steps and unnecessary verifications. The error originated from not properly distinguishing between the place of death (Kreuzlingen, Switzerland) and the burial location (Berlin-Kreuzberg, Germany). This misinterpretation caused the conversation to repeatedly attempt to verify information that was already clearly stated in the source.
